column1: # Application policies (taskiem_app, or PUBLIC) on tables with a tenant_id
# column that do not scope rows to the caller's tenants (threat model B7).
# TestEveryTenantTableIsProtected fails when such a policy is not listed
# here, or a listed one is scoped or gone: a wide policy needs a line in
# its own change, with an owner who reviewed it and a one-line reason (what
# a tenant can see or write through it, and why that is intended).

column3: A person's own copy of their conversations with businesses (taskiem-for-everyone §14): scoped to the person (taskiem_person_scope()), and, once a door names one business, to that business's rows only; tenant_id names the business, not an owner (00452)
A person's own copy of their messages with businesses: scoped to the person, and to one business once a door names it (00452)
A person's own copy of photos, voice notes and files in their conversations with businesses: scoped to the person, and to one business once a door names it (00452)
A person reports a conversation to Taskiem's moderators: insert only, as the person in scope; no tenant reads reports (00452)
